high_level_description: stc brand style, a person in traditional attire cooking outdoors at a desert campsite.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A desert setting with beige sand and sparse green vegetation in the distance, natural daylight.

elements.desc: A person wearing a white thobe and red headdress, sitting cross-legged, holding a dark cooking implement.
A portable black camping table with a large silver pot with a lid, a bowl of fresh oranges, and wrapped food items, set atop a black portable burner.
Additional dark cooking pots and utensils placed on the sandy ground in the foreground.
